scope: Defensive OSINT search for a CISA-grade external technical trigger outside Russia. No attribution is made without path/device/operator evidence.

why_it_is_high_value: Censored Planet-derived incident records in 2026 repeatedly report DNS-blocking signatures against a broad basket of US/open services, including chat.openai.com, chatgpt.com, facebook.com, google.com, instagram.com, whatsapp.com, youtube.com, reddit.com, and other services.
The pattern recurs on multiple 2026 dates, including 2026-06-03, 2026-06-10, 2026-06-24, 2026-06-28, and 2026-08-09, which is more interesting than a one-off outage.

Historical Censored Planet work on Kazakhstan demonstrated path-dependent HTTPS interception in KazTelecom AS9198 using the Kazakhstan root CA and transparent-proxy behavior, establishing that path-specific national interception capability has existed there.

Recorded Future/Insikt Group assesses that Kazakhstan almost certainly purchased Russian-origin SORM technology; Kazakhstan has also raised concerns about backdoors/continued manufacturer access in SORM equipment. This is a Russian-technology lineage signal, not proof of Moscow command.
The affected-service basket includes US companies and US-hosted/open services, satisfying the US-service nexus requirement at the service level.
negative_controls_and_caveats: The 2026 Kazakhstan blocking records currently surfaced through a Censored Planet-derived feed do not identify the responsible ASN/operator for the event.
The mechanism is reported as DNS blocking in the incident feed, but device/vendor identity for the active 2026 filter is not established.
Russian-origin SORM presence does not establish that the filtering function is implemented by that equipment, and does not establish Russian remote command.
Independent replication of the exact same 2026 event by RIPE Atlas/OONI/Cloudflare with path localization has not yet been established.
Provider-side health must be matched to the exact event window before escalation.
missing_bridge_for_red: ASN/path localization of the same selective failure
independent replication of the same event window
device/vendor/control-plane linkage for the active filtering event

evidence: On 2026-08-22, OONI-derived incident data showed elevated web-connectivity anomalies, HTTP invalid-request-line middlebox anomalies, and WhatsApp/Facebook Messenger anomalies.
On 2026-08-29, repeated HTTP invalid-request-line anomalies were again observed.

Recorded Future reports that Uzbekistan has almost certainly procured SORM hardware/software from Russian companies including MFI Soft, Protei, and VAS Experts; Uzbektelecom was reportedly a customer of MFI Soft/SORMovich.
Citizen Lab reported PROTEI equipment fingerprints in Uzbekistan in prior infrastructure research.
Global outage checks surfaced no broad WhatsApp/Facebook Messenger outage on 2026-08-22, which is a weak negative control but not a substitute for provider telemetry.
caveats: The surfaced 2026 incident evidence is primarily OONI-derived and explicitly lacks independent corroboration.
No responsible ASN/operator is identified in the surfaced incident record.
No active Russian vendor/control-plane link is established for the 2026 interference.
Uzbekistan has been partially liberalizing international gateway access since 2025, so the old single-gateway model must not be treated as current universal topology.

functional_analogs_not_russian_lineage.evidence: OONI documented TLS interference after ClientHello for Facebook, TikTok and YouTube in July-August 2026, with Google Transparency data independently showing a correlated YouTube traffic drop.
functional_analogs_not_russian_lineage.why_not_cisa_trigger: No Russian vendor/control-plane bridge is established.

functional_analogs_not_russian_lineage.evidence: After the January 2026 shutdown, some services were restored/whitelisted while major social and messaging services remained blocked on multiple networks.
functional_analogs_not_russian_lineage.why_not_cisa_trigger: No Russian vendor/control-plane bridge is established.

Kazakhstan: compare affected path with alternate transit/VPN/Starlink or other lawful alternate-path controls where public measurements exist.
Kazakhstan: look for RIPE Atlas, OONI, Cloudflare or IODA evidence overlapping the exact Censored Planet event windows.
Uzbekistan: identify ASNs behind the August 22/29 OONI middlebox anomalies and compare them against known Russian-origin SORM/vendor relationships.
For both countries: freeze provider-side health for ChatGPT/Meta/Google/YouTube at exact event timestamps to exclude destination-side incidents.
